tools.downloadSecurity: Embed yt-dlp through scripts/media/download.py, requirements.txt pins. Guard every DNS/socket connection including redirects/manifests/segments against non-global/private/reserved destinations; pin numeric connections to checked addresses. Enforce only HTTP(S), no proxy/cookies/config/plugins/auth/DRM bypass, force guarded urllib transport and native downloaders; no networking delegated to FFmpeg/external downloader. Reject URL credentials, non-80/443 ports, credentials leaking in messages. Fail closed; no allow-local development bypass.
tools.conversionSecurity: Symfony Process argv, no shell command strings; fixed filenames, path containment, typed options, safe actual input sniffing and explicit demuxers. FFprobe/FFmpeg protocol whitelist file,pipe; forbid playlist/concat/remote references, enable_drefs 0 where supported, isolated job dirs; cap dimensions/duration/output and cleanup on failure/cancel. Produce actual supported files and authenticated Range-capable assets.
tools.ux: Durable real job progress/history, honest unavailable runtime errors, source/file remove, working download/cancel, no fake generated placeholders. Remind users to download only content they own or may use.
